title: Guinness Brewery, St. James’s Gate

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Copernicus GLO-30 at the gateway entrance. Lodge foundations continue below this grade to accommodate the mapped road slope.

identities.name: Guinness Brewery, St. James’s Gate
identities.address: St. James’s Gate, Thomas Street at James’s Street, Dublin 8, Ireland

mapIdentity.scope: The NIAH identifies the main entrance and paired lodges as one architectural group. The named gate and two matching building footprints supply the coordinate, north-facing axis, width and depths.

note: The original Commons CC0 close photograph gives the gate opening proportions, granite surrounds, render, door design, sign position, parapet, date panels and east lodge return. The official inventory records the three-storey lodges, sash types, hipped roof fronts and east chimney.
